researcher_notes: No existing GEM row (checked P0760/P0765/P1368/P2425/P2426 - all Anapa-origin trunks, none is the 16-104 km Anapa-Taman parallel string). Listed as item 207 in federal plan 816-r (rev. 17.12.2025), 7.5 bcm/y. Length 88.1 km (>=25 km) = km 104.1 - 16.0 per neftegazpro; stage 1 (0-16.7 km) is a separate 16.7 km piece and not included here. Caveats: Gazprom release describes the project as km 0-104 and the first stage in progress, so the construction status for the 16-104 km stage 2 section specifically is inferred from the project-level release; stage 2 Glavgosekspertiza conclusion not found. Diameter not found (blank, no orphan value). ProposalYear/start year not sourced (blank). Cost not found.
